title: Fostering tolerance through museums: assessing visitor engagement with historical analogies at three archaeological galleries in the UK
core_idea: This study quantitatively investigates museum visitors' perceptions of historical analogies that compare the deep past with modern political ideas and assesses whether heritage sites can influence visitors' historical consciousness to foster tolerance by exposing and challenging analogies used in exclusive nationalist discourse, using responses to the Tolerant Futures interactive displayed in three UK archaeological galleries.
tldr: A quantitative study testing whether museum interventions that challenge nationalist historical analogies can shape visitors' historical consciousness and promote tolerance, by analysing engagement with an interactive exhibit in three archaeological galleries.
